address: via Zanardelli 5, Brenzone sul Garda, 37010, Italy
bio: Although the first-floor dining room at this restaurant overlooks Lake Garda, only a fortunate few will have a table with a view, so booking in advance is recommended! The new culinary philosophy here takes inspiration from the restaurant’s natural surroundings, transforming local ingredients into gastronomic works of art. Fish from the lake, game, aromatic herbs and home-grown vegetables all demonstrate the abundance of this beautiful region....
